title: Configuring a Cloud for Report Distribution

blocks.text: Usage insights provide actionable insights into an organization's usage patterns between users and applications. To learn more, see About Usage Insights.
Based on the cloud you use, you can configure its settings to enable the detailed insights report distribution to your cloud storage.
To configure a cloud for reports:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Explorer > Private Access > Usage.
Under Last Report Information, select your cloud type.
Under Cloud Configuration, enter your Bucket Name, Region, and IAM Role ARN.
For an AWS bucket, the name should always be ZscalerInsightsReportRole.
You can view the Settings window again to review your cloud configuration information.

blocks.text: To switch clouds, click Delete to switch cloud and enter your new cloud configuration.
For security purposes, Zscaler recommends rotating Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud credentials every 3 months.
